task_statement: Operator UX: ensure `doctor` runs before persistent SQLite stores, ledgers, or execution-handle stores are constructed; introduce one canonical callable loader for `module:path.to.callable`; reuse that loader from mission CLI, runtime CLI, and doctor; preserve current doctor JSON/status semantics and exit-code compatibility; add or update focused regression coverage for nested factory paths and doctor preflight behavior. Non-goals: no bootstrap/composition-root redesign, no new DI container or lifecycle abstraction, no registry/catalog/admission/certification changes.
